nodes.text_en: What issue are you facing with LG ThinQ smart features?
nodes.text_hi: LG ThinQ app ya smart features ke sath kya dikkat aa rahi hai?

options.label: Wi-Fi Pairing fails during initial setup
AC shows 'Offline / Disconnected' in ThinQ App
Model does not have Wi-Fi hardware

nodes.text_en: Is your Wi-Fi router broadcasting on 2.4 GHz band? (LG ACs only connect to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, not 5 GHz).
nodes.text_hi: Kya aapka Wi-Fi router 2.4 GHz band par hai? (LG AC sirf 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi se connect hota hai).

options.label: Connected phone to 2.4 GHz; pairing worked

nodes.text_en: After pressing the Wi-Fi button on remote for 3 seconds until the Wi-Fi icon blinks, did pairing succeed?
nodes.text_hi: Remote par Wi-Fi button 3 second dabane ke baad kya app mein AC pair ho gaya?

options.label: No, Wi-Fi icon does not blink

nodes.text_en: Did you recently change your home Wi-Fi password, router, or internet provider?
nodes.text_hi: Kya aapne haal hi mein Wi-Fi password, router ya internet connection badla hai?

options.label: No changes, router is ON with active internet

nodes.text_en: Did turning off the AC MCB for 2 minutes and restarting the ThinQ app bring the AC back online?
nodes.text_hi: AC ka MCB 2 minute band karke on karne aur app restart karne par kya AC online aaya?

diag_indoor_wifi_module_fault.probable_cause: Indoor Wi-Fi PCB Module Non-Responsive or Detached Cable
parts: LG Smart Wi-Fi USB/PCB Module (LCW-004 / LCW-007)
diag_indoor_wifi_module_fault.rag_query: LG AC ThinQ wifi module replacement troubleshooting
diag_indoor_wifi_module_fault.technician_note: Inspect Wi-Fi module connector on indoor display PCB and check 5V supply.

diag_voice_assistant_relink.probable_cause: OAuth Token Expired in Alexa / Google Home ThinQ Skill
diag_voice_assistant_relink.rag_query: LG ThinQ Alexa Google Home unlink and relink skill
diag_voice_assistant_relink.technician_note: Guide customer to unlink and re-link LG ThinQ skill inside Alexa / Google Home app.

diag_model_no_wifi_support.probable_cause: Appliance Model Lacks Built-in ThinQ Wi-Fi Hardware
diag_model_no_wifi_support.rag_query: LG AC model wifi feature compatibility check
diag_model_no_wifi_support.technician_note: Verify model suffix in manual. Non-Wi-Fi models do not support ThinQ.
